prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Columbus. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first a quick clarification so I give useful, accurate recommendations:

1) Which “Columbus” do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; Columbus, MS; another)?  
2) Any preferences or constraints? (insurance carrier, PPO vs Medicaid, budget, need same-day/”teeth in a day”/All‑on‑4, sedation or general anesthesia, bone grafting history, desire for a prosthodontist vs oral surgeon vs periodontist)  
3) Do you want practices close to a particular neighborhood/ZIP code?

If you want general guidance right away, here’s what I’ll include once you confirm the city and preferences:
- 4–6 specific practices in that Columbus with phone and website (so you can call), prioritizing:
  - Board‑certified oral & maxillofacial surgeons, board‑certified periodontists, and prosthodontists who specialize in implant restorations
  - Practices with in‑office CBCT 3D imaging, implant planning software, and experience with bone grafting/ sinus lifts if needed
  - Good online reviews and hospital or university affiliations (for complex cases)
  - Options for sedation and financing
- Why I recommend each one (expertise, experience level, technologies, typical case types they handle)
- What to ask when you call (questions that reveal skill and fit: credentials, number of implants placed per year, implant systems used, treatment timeline & costs, warranty/guarantee, sedation options)
- Typical price ranges and what drives cost (single implant, abutment, crown, grafting, extractions)

Tell me which Columbus and any preferences and I’ll compile the specific practices and why to call them.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
